# GitCode Viewer

Desktop-class Git on mobile: clone, pull, branch, log, diff, and blame, with offline reading and PDF / Office / Jupyter preview. Supports GitHub, GitLab, Gitee, self-hosted servers, SSH, and private repositories.

## Canonical URLs
- https://gitcodeviewer.xdnote.com/
- https://gitcodeviewer.xdnote.com/privacy/

## Key Product Facts
- Desktop-class Git on mobile: clone, pull, branch, log, tag, checkout, diff.
- Inline Git blame, author annotations, and historical revision viewing.
- Syntax highlighting, outline, and symbols for 30+ languages.
- Preview PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, CSV, and Jupyter notebooks.
- Markdown rendering with Mermaid diagrams and LaTeX math.
- GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps, Gitea, Gitee, CNB, and self-hosted servers.
- SSH and private repository support.
- Offline reading, no analytics or tracking.

## FAQ (Search-Friendly)
- Q: Is GitCode Viewer free?
  A: Free to use with no account required. Some advanced features require upgrading to the premium version.
- Q: Which programming languages and code formats are supported?
  A: Syntax highlighting covers 30+ programming languages and 100+ file extensions. Major languages (C, C++, C#, Go, Rust, Java, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, PHP, Bash, and more) also get code outline and symbol navigation.
- Q: Which document formats can it preview?
  A: Markdown, PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, RTF, CSV / TSV, Mermaid diagrams, and Jupyter notebooks.
- Q: Which Git providers does GitCode Viewer support?
  A: GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps, Gitea, Gitee, and CNB, as well as self-hosted Git servers - including servers on your intranet.
- Q: Does it support SSH and private repositories?
  A: Yes. You can connect over SSH or with access tokens, and credentials are stored only on your device.
- Q: Can I read repositories offline?
  A: Yes. After cloning, code, documents, and full Git history are all available offline.
- Q: Is the premium upgrade shared between Android and iOS?
  A: No. Upgrades are billed through each app store: a purchase made on Google Play cannot be used on iOS, and vice versa. Switching platforms requires purchasing the upgrade again in the respective store.
- Q: Does GitCode Viewer collect user data?
  A: No. It collects no analytics, no tracking, and no telemetry. Network traffic goes directly between your device and your Git provider.
